title: Length assigned to a digit list
statement: Assign a natural number to each finite list of natural numbers as follows: the empty list has length $1$; a list with first entry $d$ and tail $L$ has assigned length equal to the assigned length of $L$, plus $1$, plus another $1$ when $d$ is nonzero.
